title: Organized courses and saved-place navigation verified
summary: Course groups, status filters, search and per-course continuation verified for new and returning learners in Arabic, English and French.

changes.detail: Repeatable unit and browser checks for independent course checkpoints, shared lessons, completion, legacy progress and reload persistence.
Compact mobile course controls, clearer Arabic progress counts, and consistent started-course detection on the home and learning screens.
Resolved initial TypeScript label/optional-value errors and verified course-aware resume links with saved lesson stages.

validation.name: Typecheck and focused lint
validation.detail: TypeScript passed after corrections. ESLint passed for all eight affected application source files. git diff --check passed.

validation.name: Progress, course library and history tests
validation.detail: 20 tests passed: complete category coverage, fresh progress, separate checkpoints after JSON reload, shared-lesson ownership, completion/next lesson, legacy data, existing course navigation and six change-history/archive tests.

validation.name: Browser checks
validation.detail: 24 viewport cases at 320, 390, 768 and 1280px across Arabic/English/French, new/light and returning/dark states. Checked search, categories, all/my/completed views, save/remove, course-context resume, saved practice stage, reload persistence, switching courses, and Arabic home resume. No page errors or horizontal overflow.

validation.name: Visual review
validation.detail: Reviewed Arabic new/returning library and course-list screenshots. Reduced mobile filter spacing and used explicit Arabic completed-count wording to avoid reversed slash fractions.

validation.name: History preservation
validation.detail: Manifest validated with 356 reports before this follow-up. Append-only reports preserved.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Browser testing uses isolated profiles with synthetic authentication. No physical Android/iOS devices, real-account login or production deployment tested. Existing progress without recorded course context uses available lesson history; no start dates are invented.

preview.label: Current organized courses (not a historical snapshot)
